# Final Report

LAW_CHANGE_APPLICATION_REQUIRED_OPEN_LOCAL_PROGRAM

## Summary

The current repository defines `open-local-workbench` as a localhost workbench opener. The requested iPhone Mirroring Facebook map requires a governed macOS local program opener. Because the Open blueprint states that the frozen law must not be modified, implementation is blocked until the Open law is corrected to authorize `open-local-program` or an equivalent local program child under the existing Open ability group.
